steps.name: install-parallel-dataset-generator
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = d337c1dae44404cadb7a63a87bb9caf4c35eec18; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage7a-parallel/climate_dataset_parallel.py > tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage7a-parallel/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py > tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: bit-exact-parallel-gate
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py -q; .venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: parallel-full-audit-regression-and-publish
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from tools.ml.climate_dataset import ClimateDatasetConfig, assert_climate_dataset_ready, audit_climate_dataset
from tools.ml.climate_dataset_parallel import generate_climate_dataset_parallel
config = ClimateDatasetConfig.full(seed=1847)
bundle = generate_climate_dataset_parallel(config, workers=4)
report = audit_climate_dataset(bundle)
print('CLIMATE_V6_PARALLEL_FULL_AUDIT')
for line in report.summary_lines():
    print(line)
print('families=', report.family_counts)
print('splits=', report.split_counts)
print('mean_level=', report.mean_level)
print('conflicting_temperature_rows=', report.conflicting_temperature_rows)
print('conflicting_humidity_rows=', report.conflicting_humidity_rows)
assert_climate_dataset_ready(report, require_family_coverage_in_each_split=True, bundle=bundle)
print('FULL_DATASET_GATE=PASS')
PY
git add -- tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add deterministic parallel climate dataset generation'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
